name: Linear — Basic annual-billing price
condition: Notify me if the advertised USD per-user monthly-equivalent price for Linear Basic, billed yearly, changes. Ignore Business, Enterprise, monthly-billing offers, feature lists and formatting.

name: Loops — Growth starting price
condition: Notify me if the advertised USD monthly starting price of the existing Growth plan changes. Ignore contact-count slider choices, Free, Enterprise, add-ons, feature changes and trial offers.

name: Loops — genuinely new plan under $50
condition: Notify me if they launch a plan under $50 per month.

name: Fathom — 100,000 pageviews monthly price
condition: Notify me if the USD monthly subscription price for up to 100,000 monthly pageviews changes. Ignore yearly billing, other pageview tiers, extra-site add-ons, trials and formatting.

name: D1 — paid rows-written unit rate
condition: Notify me if the USD rate per million rows written on Workers Paid changes. Ignore the Free plan, included monthly quota, storage, read pricing, documentation dates and examples.

name: Linux — explicitly stable release
condition: Notify me if the version explicitly labelled stable changes. Ignore mainline releases, rc builds, longterm branches, release-date-only changes and site news.

name: Go — published stable version
condition: Notify me when the published Go version number changes. Ignore build timestamps and whitespace-only changes.

name: OpenCode — latest stable release tag
condition: Notify me if the release tag of the latest stable OpenCode release changes. Ignore GitHub navigation, stars, reactions, download counts, asset or checksum changes, release-note edits for the same tag, and prerelease tags.
